lines: Caveman makes a web page take only 121 tokens instead of 15,704 for a Playwright snapshot.
Agents chatter between tool calls and say too much before answering.
Caveman is a simple voice for coding agents that answers first with no greeting.
It shrinks file logs and code comments to under one percent of their size while keeping every number and path exact.
The proxy cuts 33.2% fewer input tokens across a whole session with 18 of 18 answers right.
The skill shrinks memory files like CLAUDE.md by 46% while keeping every heading intact.
It turns code comments and memory files into tiny summaries that keep all paths safe.
It works in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Copilot, and 30+ more tools.
Julius Brussee made it, Apache-2.0 license, Adobe Research tested it, and it has 110358 stars.
Add the skill with npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman -g to your project.
Save this for a project that needs fewer tokens and exact paths.
Caveman speaks less to save tokens.
